vocabulary.definition: widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something on the basis of their achievements or quality.
vocabulary.example: The prestigious award ceremony honored individuals who have shown exceptional talent in their respective fields.

vocabulary.definition: information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote a political cause or point of view.
vocabulary.example: The government distributed propaganda materials to sway public opinion in their favor.

vocabulary.definition: relating to or characteristic of the middle class, typically with reference to its perceived materialistic values or conventional attitudes.
vocabulary.example: The novel depicted the bourgeois lifestyle of a family living in a suburban neighborhood.

vocabulary.definition: mending a hole or a worn-out fabric using needle and thread.
vocabulary.example: She spent the afternoon darning her favorite pair of socks to make them wearable again.

vocabulary.definition: opposing or lacking the characteristics typically associated with a hero, such as bravery, nobility, or exceptional abilities.
vocabulary.example: The film portrayed the protagonist as an anti-heroic figure, showcasing his flaws and moral ambiguity.

vocabulary.definition: synchronized or in harmony with something else.
vocabulary.example: Her actions were not in synch with her words, causing confusion among the audience.
